items.title: Gifted evaluation window, probably not needed for her
items.detail: LCPS opened the fall evaluation cycle for grades 6 to 8. The Permission to Evaluate form is due Friday 25 Sep and late forms are refused, though sixth and seventh graders get another cycle in January 2027. She is already scheduled in Spectrum 6 with Mrs. Cumberledge, which is the identified gifted programme, so this almost certainly does not apply to her. One question to the school gifted resource teacher settles it. Form link sits on the LCPS Gifted and Talented page.

items.title: New teacher messaging app, Rooms by Apptegy
items.detail: LCPS launched a two way messaging tool this year. It becomes the only channel for quick notes from teachers, coaches and activity leaders. Invitations went out 2 Sep by text or email and will be resent next week, but you can join without one. Download the LCPS app, allow notifications, pick Watson Mountain in the Feed tab, then use the Rooms or Messaging tab at the bottom. Schoology still holds assignments and ParentVUE still holds grades.

items.title: FY28 budget ThoughtExchange closes 15 Sep
items.detail: Optional. The School Board is collecting parent input on programs and investments for the 2027 to 2028 year, with slower revenue growth expected. Open at lcps.org/thoughtexchange.

items.title: Video Game Music Club, she is not eligible yet
items.detail: Runs Wednesdays after school, led by Mr. Klinberg. Sixth graders need at least one full year of playing plus permission from Ms. Holowecki, so this is a no for now. Ms. Holowecki is starting a Beginning Strings Club for beginners in the second club season and will send details as the first season closes. Fee carries an extra $15 that pays the professional guest musicians.

items.title: Fall club registration has already closed
items.detail: Registration opened to all families Sunday 6 Sep at 10:00 am and closed Monday 7 Sep. Several clubs sold out during PTO priority access before that. Bus transport was offered for PM sessions only. Year long clubs are separate and the PTO says details are still coming, so that is the next window to watch. Club questions go to clubs@watsonmountainpto.org.

items.title: Check she has the right math notebook
items.detail: Mrs. Reel asked families to verify it. The class uses it daily for notes, examples and practice.

items.title: Math homework runs on Mathspace, most nights
items.detail: Mrs. Reel expects homework after most classes, due the following class period, mostly on Mathspace. Every unit also has a Schoology folder with an agenda listing each day, assignments, completed notes and upcoming test dates. That agenda is the first place to look after an absence.

scans.summary: Page changes, no new mail. Due times now show on the card, so the Spectrum task reads 4:00 pm rather than just Tuesday. Work she has handed in but that is not graded stays on the board for three days marked submitted, instead of vanishing. Task rows carry a link straight to Schoology. Mathspace and Rooms added to the quick links, a bus line added under the header, and a quarter end countdown appears inside 30 days. Coursework text is now escaped like everywhere else, the holiday calendar is written once instead of three times, and the script moved out to app.js so the file can be pushed normally again.

Good day. The overdue Histograms task came back 100/100, so it was submitted and it cost nothing. PE Procedures and Rules major summative also posted 100/100. Both of yesterday's deadlines are closed: Vocab Unit 1 test submitted at 12:02 pm and the Science OIP quiz at 2:56 pm, neither graded yet. One new item, a Spectrum 6 Field Methods task due Tuesday 15 Sep at 4:00 pm, which is an afternoon deadline rather than the usual midnight. Nothing left on the list until then. RSM is tonight at 6:20 with Lesson 1 homework due. Yom Kippur on Monday 21 Sep is a student holiday and was already on the calendar. Still open: math notebook check, shoulder rest, and the Art 6 supply list from Ms. Thiele.
No mail scan. Removed the two study checklists from What to do and switched the feature off in the page so future tests do not generate them. The tests themselves still show as dated rows.

Histograms is now a day overdue and it is the only thing on the list that costs marks. Schoology flagged it this evening as an overdue Math 7 submission, so it was not turned in Tuesday night. Two grades posted since last night, both full marks, and Week 3 Fitness Testing came back at 20/20 even though the window runs to Friday, so that one is finished and off the list. Tomorrow is the heavy day: Vocab Unit 1 test, OIP quiz by 11:59 pm, and RSM at 6:20 pm. Nothing new arrived from teachers or the PTO. Pages deploy is healthy again after the 8 Sep failure.

Caught a deployment fault first: this morning's push built cleanly but the Pages deploy step failed, so the site had been serving 7 Sep data all day. This push retriggers it. Three new assignments landed today, one of them Histograms due tonight. Three grades posted, all full marks. Added the gifted evaluation window with the caveat that Spectrum 6 likely already covers her.

Scanned five days of school mail. Nothing new has arrived since last night: the latest Schoology digest and the 7 Sep Mountain Messenger were both already captured. One real gap closed, fall club registration shut on 7 Sep, so there is no link still pending. Year long clubs from the PTO are the next window. Coursework is unchanged and correct: OIP study guide due tonight, two minor summatives Thursday, art portfolio 23 Oct.

Fixed a real fault: study steps dated ahead of today were hidden, so both test cards showed an empty progress bar with nothing to tap. Steps are now grouped under day headings and always tappable, so ticking one moves the bar and the per day chips straight away.

Added day by day progress. Each study plan now shows a chip per day with steps set against steps done, and the What to do block keeps a rolling seven day log so a finished or missed day leaves a trace after the rows reset.

Every What to do row is now tappable. Striking one through updates a done count in the header and syncs like the study steps. Day bound jobs such as the violin reset each morning, standing jobs stay struck until the data changes.

Built the sync worker. sync-worker.js and SYNC-SETUP.md added to the repo. The page gained SYNC_URL and SYNC_KEY placeholders and a Sync now button; until the worker URL is filled in it falls back to a copyable code. No token is in the page.
